title: 6 Trucks That Hold Their Value After 5 Years (The Real Numbers)
description:
One pickup keeps about eighty percent of its value after five years. The best-selling truck in America loses nearly thirty-nine percent. On a sixty thousand dollar truck, that is a difference of more than eleven thousand dollars. And the truck that holds its value best of all might not be the one you expect. Here are the trucks that hold their value, with the real numbers.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
2:28 1. Toyota Tacoma
4:07 2. Toyota Tundra
5:17 3. Heavy-duty trucks
6:20 4. The rest of the midsize trucks
7:25 5. Small trucks
8:27 6. The best-selling full-size trucks
13:52 The lesson
19:59 What to check before you buy in 2027

Sources:
The data we use comes from iSeeCars, which analyzed more than three million vehicles to calculate how much value each model keeps after five years. Their truck pages list the five-year resale value, which is the share of the original price a truck is still worth. We turn that into depreciation by subtracting from one hundred percent. And we use a May twenty twenty-six article from SlashGear for the dollar figures. Every source is listed in the description.

Photos from Wikimedia Commons, full credits and licenses: https://github.com/viniciushoscher-ctrl/american-trucks/blob/main/agendamento/creditos/video08.md
